title.narrative: ROAP/IRN Emergency support to Learning Spaces and Schools, after June 2024 Earthquake in Khorasan Razavi Province, I.R. Iran

description.narrative:
Several infrastructures, including schools in the settlements, suffered damage during a strong earthquake on June 18, 2024, in the vicinity of Kashmar city, Khorasan Razavi province, northeast Iran. This project aims to provide emergency support for the repair and reconstruction of safe, sustainable and climate-adaptive schools and learning spaces, as well as to support resilient communities in the affected area. Additionally, the project offers an opportunity to develop the necessary knowledge and experience for repairing seismically damaged urban infrastructure. The project encompasses two main outputs: i) Effective urban risk mitigation and response in educational infrastructures (in line with SP4) and ii) Strengthened climate action in educational infrastructures and communities (in line with SP3). Goal: Immediate support to urban infrastructure and socio-economic needs through providing resilient and sustainable learning spaces and schools for the affected areas of Khorasan Razavi province by the earthquakes Approach: A desk study, field investigation, field construction work and supporting participatory planning and implementation for improving resilience of the settlement will be followed. Methodology: Encompassing two main Outputs, the project aims at restoring the damaged schools and learning space, and improving the climate resilience of the facilities, resulting in a building back better process. The project also aims at expanding international cooperation and capacity-building support in activities and programmes for improving the resilience of learning spaces and schools, including repair/reconstruction of water supply system and plans for water efficiency, wastewater treatment, recycling and reuse technologies in small settlements and villages. It also provides workshops for raising public awareness about the consequences of cliamate change in the region, adaptation methods and creation of job and small businesses.
Activities • Studies for development of plans for enhancing sustainability and resilience in the human settlemtns in the affected area, based on gender-responsive plans • Reconstruction of damaged water infrastructure in the region including a water storage tank partial reconstruction of water distribution system for one village and • Holding workshops for upgrading resilience and public awareness in society about mitigation of consequences of destructive earthquakes and climate change in the human settlements
Expected results The main expected accomplishments include: i) One 500m3 water storage tank and partial reconstructed of water distribution system in one village. ii) 2 plans for organization of 2 damaged villages with the aim of creating sustainable job creation and livelihood mechanism considering climate change consequences Public resilience and awareness on climate change in two village about mitigation of consequences of destructive earthquakes and climate change in the human settlements
